pageDescription: Goals, reviews and skills — how work is planned, judged and recorded.

workspace.noEmployeeLink: Your account isn't linked to an employee record, so there is nothing personal to show here. Ask HR to link your account.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: What each person is working toward — drafts become active, then complete.
goals.denied: You don't have permission to view these goals.
goals.empty: No goals yet. Create a goal to start tracking progress.
goals.emptyFiltered: No goals match these filters. Clear a filter or choose another status.
goals.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every goal field.
goals.label: Goals
goals.containerLabel: Goals. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

goalForm.createDescription: Create a goal in draft, then activate it when work starts.
goalForm.editDescription: Update the goal while it is a draft or active. Completing or cancelling is a separate, terminal action.
goalForm.employeeHint: The person this goal belongs to. It can't change after creation.
goalForm.title: Goal
goalForm.descriptionHint: Sensitive: visible to the employee, their manager and HR, never included in events.
goalForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What success looks like and the first concrete step.
goalForm.dueDateHint: Past dates are allowed — goals are plans, not claims.
goalForm.progressHint: 0–100. Completing a goal never changes progress automatically.

goalState.activateDescription: Activate “{title}”? The employee can then record progress until the goal completes or is cancelled.
goalState.completeDescription: Complete “{title}”? This is terminal — a completed goal can't be edited or re-opened.
goalState.cancelDescription: Cancel “{title}”? This is terminal — the goal can't be re-opened. Progress stays as recorded.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Completed reviews and the ones still in progress.
reviews.myDescription: Your completed reviews. Drafts stay with your manager until they are finished.
reviews.denied: You don't have permission to view these reviews.
reviews.empty: No reviews yet. A review appears here after a manager starts one.
reviews.emptyMine: No completed reviews yet. Your manager's drafts stay hidden until they finish.
reviews.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every review field.
reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.containerLabel: Reviews. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Peer input on a review, visible to the review author and HR.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: The tenant skill catalog. Employee skills build on it.
skills.denied: You don't have permission to view the skill catalog.
skills.empty: No skills in the catalog yet.
skills.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every skill field.
skills.label: Skills
skills.containerLabel: Skills. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

errors.reviewNotFound: This review is no longer available.
errors.reviewIncomplete: Add a rating before completing the review.
errors.reviewNotDraft: This review is no longer a draft. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.feedbackProviderInvalid: Choose active employees other than the reviewer and the employee being reviewed.
errors.feedbackAlreadySubmitted: You already submitted feedback for this review.
errors.feedbackAccessDenied: Feedback is visible to the review author and HR only.
errors.skillNameTaken: A skill with this name already exists, including archived skills.
errors.skillArchived: This skill is archived and can't be assigned to anyone new.
errors.employeeSkillExists: This employee already has this skill. Update the existing row instead.
errors.employeeNotActive: That employee is no longer active and can't be given new goals or reviews.
errors.employeeNotFound: Choose an employee from your organization.
errors.skillNotFound: This skill is no longer available.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to manage performance.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: This item is no longer available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.descriptionTooLong: Description must be at most 2,000 characters
